reason: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/lib/utilities.js:246 sets `maxSizeKB = 10 * 1024` in the 413 branch, replacing `Discourse.SiteSettings.max_image_size_kb`, so a 413 from a web server configured below 10 MB (which config/nginx.sample.conf:60-61 says to keep in sync with the site setting) reports "maximum size is 10240kb".
